indie_battletower001.name: Silver Watercutter: Normal
indie_battletower001.description: I saw a sliver of light and the flashing blade streaking through the flowing currents, yet it failed to sever its cold, heartless malice. Its grip left its taint upon your sword, and the lingering echo shrouded your form.
indie_battletower001.featureDesc:
<@ba.info>- Enemies have better stats.</>

indie_battletower003.name: Skirmishers' Æthillu: Normal
indie_battletower003.description: I see a crossbow bolt screech across the heavens. The skirmishers trod along the very brink of reality, their features blending into the cold forms of the Æthillu.
indie_battletower003.featureDesc:
- Enemies cannot move but are harder to interrupt.
 - Æthillu that can only be damaged by finishers will appear in the battlefield.
 - Defeating an Æthillu will pull in all enemies, recover 50 SP, and give the controlled operator DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+100%</> for 10s.
 - Defeat all Bonekrusher Ambushers to clear the stage; defeating the Æthillu is not required.

 <@ba.info>- Enemies have better stats.</>
 <@ba.info>- Only HP Treatment tacticals and consumables can be used.</>

indie_battletower006.name: Scars of Landbreaking: Normal
indie_battletower006.description: I learned of a story that started with a warlord's wild ambitions. It led to packs of wolves devouring each other and churned the great sea of sand, till the sound of blood gushing from the broken gashes echoed in our ears.
indie_battletower006.featureDesc:
- Defeating the Bonekrusher Vanguard grants Stagger Efficiency Bonus <@ba.vup>+50%</>.
 - Defeating the Bonekrusher Arsonist grants Arts Intensity <@ba.vup>+100</>.
 - Defeating the Bonekrusher Executioner grants Skill DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+100%</>.
 - Defeating the Heavy Ram grants Basic Attack DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+100%</>.

indie_hard001.name: Rampaging Shields
indie_hard001.description:
The snowy fog never seems to dissipate from these wildlands. Crisp sounds of shattering could be heard hidden within the low rumblings. 
Listen close. Did you hear ... stone grinding against metal?

indie_hard001_s.name: Rampaging Shields: Agony
indie_hard001_s.description:
The snowy fog never seems to dissipate from these wildlands. Crisp sounds of shattering could be heard hidden within the low rumblings. 
Listen close. Did you hear ... stone grinding against metal?
indie_hard001_s.featureDesc:
- Enemies are stronger.
 - Enemies move faster and recover from Staggered more quickly.
 - When an enemy is defeated, the remaining enemies become harder to interrupt, and continuously gain ATK and HP restoration.

  <@ba.info>- Tacticals and consumables cannot be used.</>

indie_hard002.name: Bolts and Shadows
indie_hard002.description:
The deafening blast brought embers of war from a century ago. Nevertheless, the Civilization Band was not destroyed by the Aggeloid bombardment. 
"It wasn't just the Aggeloi that brought humanity close to extinction. And that is the tragedy."

indie_hard002_s.name: Bolts and Shadows: Agony
indie_hard002_s.description:
The deafening blast brought embers of war from a century ago. Nevertheless, the Civilization Band was not destroyed by the Aggeloid bombardment. 
"It wasn't just the Aggeloi that brought humanity close to extinction. And that is the tragedy."
indie_hard002_s.featureDesc:
- Enemies are stronger.
 - Enemies recover from Staggered more quickly, are harder to interrupt, and have greatly increased ATK range.
 - Heavy Sting α gains temporary immunity against all DMG regularly; defeat all Sting α to remove this immunity buff.
 
  <@ba.info>- Tacticals and consumables cannot be used.</>

indie_hard003.name: Rock Solid
indie_hard003.description:
The giant machine wreckage in the distance heralded the great events of the past. Nearby, disassembled entities began to coalesce, creating newborn entities that belched with earth-rending howls. 
The land began to tremble as the Aggeloi slammed into the ground and waded their ponderous steps.

indie_hard003_s.name: Rock Solid: Agony
indie_hard003_s.description:
The giant machine wreckage in the distance heralded the great events of the past. Nearby, disassembled entities began to coalesce, creating newborn entities that belched with earth-rending howls. 
The land began to tremble as the Aggeloi slammed into the ground and waded their ponderous steps.
indie_hard003_s.featureDesc:
- Operator Stamina regeneration rate is greatly reduced.
 - Enemies are stronger and immune to Stagger.
 - The Walking Chrysopolis recovers from weakpoint exposures more quickly. Failing to destroy a weakpoint before weakpoint exposure ends gives the Walking Chrysopolis a massive ATK buff. Successfully destroying the weakpoint applies Staggered to the Walking Chrysopolis.

  <@ba.info>- Tacticals and consumables cannot be used.</>

indie_hard004.name: Ballista and Axe
indie_hard004.description:
The Bonekrusher warriors eviscerated the weak and stood atop the platform with their axe and ballista raised. Defeat them and lay both ancient suffering and newfound ambition in the dust. 
"Hero? How did you earn this title?"
indie_hard004.featureDesc: - The 2 elite enemies will fight as a team.
